title: Concept: Podfile.lock spec without a checksum
description: Podfile.lock declares a locked pod that records no checksum, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: CocoaPods cannot verify the downloaded pod against the lockfile, so a substituted pod installs silently.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Podfile.lock (cocoapods).
risk: CocoaPods cannot verify the downloaded pod against the lockfile, so a substituted pod installs silently.
